module_summary: AXI write-channel FIFO: W beats are packed into a 32-entry RAM via wr/rd pointers and drained through a read stage and output register, while AW and B channels pass through.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO RAM storing packed W beats (data, strobe, last)

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO write pointer advanced on each accepted W beat; drives full/empty

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO read pointer advanced on each RAM read; drives full/empty

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave W valid; triggers FIFO write when not full

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Slave W ready, asserted when FIFO not full and not held

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Master W valid from output register valid

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: Master W ready; allows output register to load next beat

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Slave write data packed into FIFO word

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Master write data unpacked from output register

anchors.name: m_axi_w_reg
anchors.why: Output register holding W beat presented to master

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag blocking writes and deasserting wready

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag blocking reads and invalidating read stage

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave AW valid bypassed to master AW channel

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address bypassed to master interface

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Master AW valid driven directly by slave awvalid

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid bypassed from master B channel

anchors.name: mem_read_data_reg
anchors.why: RAM read-data register between FIFO memory and output register

anchors.name: mem_read_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Valid flag of RAM read stage; gates reads and output valid

anchors.name: write
anchors.why: FIFO RAM write enable on accepted W beat

anchors.name: read
anchors.why: FIFO RAM read enable loading mem_read_data_reg

anchors.name: store_output
anchors.why: Load enable for output register when master ready or idle

anchors.name: hold
anchors.why: Write-hold flag, tied 0 when FIFO_DELAY disabled; gates wready

anchors.name: s_axi_w
anchors.why: Packed W word (data, strobe, last) written into FIFO

groups.name: Write FIFO
groups.description: Dual-pointer RAM FIFO buffering W beats with registered read stage

groups.name: W output register
groups.description: Output register presenting W beats to the master with valid/ready

groups.name: Slave W input
groups.description: Slave W handshake and payload feeding FIFO writes

groups.name: AW and B bypass
groups.description: Write address and response channels wired straight through
